name: rankforge
description: RankForge — Production-ready commercial SEO Automation SaaS

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:security && npm run test:integration && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:unit: npx tsx tests/unit/ssrf.test.ts && npx tsx tests/unit/audit.test.ts && npx tsx tests/unit/credit.test.ts && npx tsx tests/unit/job-atomic.test.ts && npx tsx tests/unit/credit-atomic.test.ts && npx tsx tests/unit/timeout.test.ts
scripts.test:security: npx tsx tests/security/tenant-isolation.test.ts && npx tsx tests/security/cross-tenant.test.ts
scripts.test:integration: npx tsx tests/integration/auth.test.ts && npx tsx tests/integration/project.test.ts && npx tsx tests/integration/job-concurrency.test.ts && npx tsx tests/integration/credit-ledger.test.ts && npx tsx tests/integration/ssrf-e2e.test.ts && npx tsx tests/integration/crawl-safety.test.ts && npx tsx tests/integration/seo-audit.test.ts && npx tsx tests/integration/idempotency.test.ts && npx tsx tests/integration/api-contract.test.ts
scripts.test:e2e: npx tsx tests/e2e/rtl-persian.test.ts && npx tsx tests/e2e/persian-negative.test.ts && npx tsx scripts/i18n-audit.ts
scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit && npm run test:security && npm run test:integration && npm run test:e2e
scripts.docker:build: docker build -t rankforge-web . && docker build -t rankforge-api -f apps/api/Dockerfile .
